title: Somewhat opaque and the confetti just sits at the bottom
text:
Somewhat opaque and the confetti just sits at the bottom. These balloons have been a total disappointment.
I'm going to go out on a limb and say maybe you have to fill them with helium to get the sheer affect with the confetti floating or sticking to the sides even? I can tell you this, just blowing them up leaves you with a somewhat opaque white-ish balloon with a bunch of paper stuck at the bottom.

I purchased these because I thought my balloon obsessed toddler would like seeing the paper float about in a clear balloon. We were both underwhelmed. She occasionally like to shake them up, but it doesn't really do all that much and if you were to blow them up and hang them, all the paper would just settle to the bottom - not much in the terms of decor. I would definitely skip these.
